subject: AtlasAI technical deep-dive and architecture handoff — calendar coordination

From: Samir Gupta <samir@atlasai.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AtlasAI — technical deep-dive request (post-discovery)

Hi Rafael / Marissa,

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning — we got a lot out of it. AtlasAI is excited about Redwood's approach to inference economics and the routing/caching ideas you mentioned. The next step for us is a technical deep-dive with our architecture and infra teams so we can validate network, VPC, and model-compatibility constraints before procurement.

Goal: 60–75 minute architecture review + Q&A covering: network connectivity (VPC peering / private link options), data retention & audit logs, performance profiling for short-response workloads, and a draft mutual action plan.

Attendees from our side: Samir Gupta (eng lead), Lena Ortiz (platform eng). Can you propose 2–3 windows next week (PST) and include any prep materials we should review? We prefer mornings (10:00–12:00 PT) but can flex.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—Samir
Samir Gupta
Director of Engineering, AtlasAI
samir@atlasai.com

Hi Samir — great to hear. Thanks for the clear agenda. 

We can run the session and will bring one of our inference engineers and a solutions architect to walk through topology options and performance expectations. Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue 25 Aug, 10:30–11:45 PT
- Wed 26 Aug, 11:00–12:15 PT
- Thu 27 Aug, 10:00–11:15 PT

If any of those work, we’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and a Zoom link. Attached is a one-page draft agenda and a high-level network diagram so your infra folks have something to look at beforehand.

Thanks,
